title: PVP: An Image Dataset for Personalized Visual Persuasion with Persuasion Strategies, Viewer Characteristics, and Persuasiveness Ratings
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on measuring the persuasiveness of images based on viewer demographics and psychological characteristics (Big 5 personality traits, Schwartz's basic values, and Moral Foundations Theory).
findings: There were no findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study. The paper mentions 'religious art' once in the introduction as a historical example of visual persuasion but does not incorporate religion into its dataset, experiments, or analysis.
